_about: Media the 2024 backups lacked, recovered November 2026 (see docs/MIGRATION.md). 'aliases': an old page asked for a file at a path where it never existed, and the same file is already on the media server under another key; the page now shows that key (nothing to upload). 'files': recovered copies staged in the transfer folder (recovered/ + recovered-variants/, listed in recovered-map.tsv); build.py adds them to the file list and media info, so they must be uploaded first.
